estimates.assumptions: 300ml sushi rice ≈ 240g uncooked short-grain rice (standard density ~0.8 g/ml); values for uncooked as the base for the whole recipe before any added ingredients.
100ml rice wine (mirin-style) ≈ 136g; typical values for sweetened Japanese rice wine used in sushi seasoning.
2 tbs caster sugar ≈ 25g; standard granulated sugar nutritional values.
3 tbs mayonnaise ≈ 45g; typical full-fat Japanese/kewpie-style mayo (higher fat than standard).
1 tbs rice wine (mirin) ≈ 18g; modest quantity for seasoning/dressing element.
1 tbs soy sauce ≈ 15g; standard fermented soy sauce values.
1 medium cucumber ≈ 300g whole, edible portion after peeling/seeding for sushi ≈ 200g; modest whole-recipe contribution.
